name: DLEAPP
description: Desktop Logs, Events and Protobuf Parser
report_description: DLEAPP is an open source project that aims to parse desktop application data for the purpose of triage analysis.
objective: Triage desktop application data from Windows, macOS and Linux.
source_hint: A tar, zip or gz archive, a disk image (raw image, E01, AFF, DMG or virtual disk, L01 or AD1), or a folder holding a computer's files or a desktop application's data folder. Several disk images of a RAID set can be picked together.

secrets.title: PASSWORDS AND KEYS
secrets.subtitle: The passwords and keys are optional

fields.name: signal
fields.label: Optional. For a current Signal Desktop profile: its 64-character database key, the 'Signal Safe Storage' password (macOS), or the secret Signal stored in libsecret or kwallet (Linux).
fields.if_absent: No Signal key: a Signal Desktop profile that wraps its key stays encrypted.

fields.name: threema
fields.label: Optional. A Threema Desktop profile's local password, or its 64-character hexadecimal database key.
fields.if_absent: No Threema password or key: an encrypted Threema Desktop database stays encrypted.

fields.name: windows_user_password
fields.label: Optional. A Windows account's password, which opens what DPAPI protects for it: its Vault, and the passwords and cookies of Chromium browsers.
fields.if_absent: No Windows user password: what DPAPI protects stays encrypted, unless Windows kept a key that opens it.

fields.name: exodus_password
fields.label: Optional. Tried as the passphrase of an Exodus desktop wallet's seed.seco. A wallet that kept its generated passphrase needs none.
fields.if_absent: No Exodus wallet password: a wallet its user protected with a password stays encrypted.
